description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Horseshoe Crab, untapping the Island.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping Horseshoe Crab.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.
